_note: Human-overrule axis-separated re-score (2026-07-11), per verify-outputs-rule: the original adjudication.json bundled tick-quality with collateral damage into one FAIL-if-any-defect verdict per gen. Conner overruled that bundling: 'the baked tik marks are all actually perfect, except maybe the baked text. other than that the ticks look near perfect, unless i am missing something.' This file separates the 4 axes from direct full-res crop re-inspection this pass (several deterministic knob-crop boxes in scores.json were confirmed OFF-TARGET on gens with layout drift, so their pixel spans measure noise, not the real ticks -- see 'det_crop_on_target' below). Angle readings here are hand-verified clock-position reads against full-res crops, not the noisy detector.

_axis_legend.1_tick_quality: marks present at socket, visually coherent/themed, start/end (or center) distinguishable BY SHAPE, angular consistency
_axis_legend.2_collateral_text: MIN/MAX/CENTER or any baked text/label leakage
_axis_legend.3_collateral_layout: knob/control rendered off its known template socket position
_axis_legend.4_collateral_bleed: guide-colour icon/button tinting (known baseline failure mode, unrelated to tick clause)

_reconciliation.angle_register_across_all_tick_bearing_g: start clocks read 7-8 o'clock (-120 to -150deg), end clocks read 4-5 o'clock (+120 to +150deg) against the -135/+135 shipped convention -- spread is roughly +-25deg around the target, consistent across both themes, both arms, and every seed that produced a tick arc. Re-verified 2026-07-11 against the newly re-anchored, properly-centered crops -- every axis1 tick-quality and clock-position call held on direct re-inspection, no flips.
_reconciliation.layout_drift_quantified_2026-07-11: Every one of the 6 painted+detected gens has a measurable knob offset from its template socket (mask-guide-colour centroid vs results.json knob_center_frac): fa-pod-ticks_ctr-501 4.41r, fa-pod-ticks_ctr-502 6.34r, fa-pod-ticks01-502 1.41r, steam-ticks01-401 3.56r, steam-ticks01-402 3.58r, steam-ticks_ctr-401 2.68r, steam-ticks_ctr-402 2.75r (r = knob radius). This is why EVERY original crop-knob.png in the pre-fix page was miscentered to some degree -- it was always template-anchored, never re-measured from the actual paint. Two axis3_layout severities were corrected as a result: steam-ticks_ctr-401 and steam-ticks_ctr-402 were called 'minor' but measure 2.7x radius -- comparable to the gens already called MAJOR -- and are reclassified to MAJOR. fa-pod-ticks01-502 was called 'none' but measures 1.41x radius and is reclassified to minor. See each gen's axis3_notes and detected_knob_frac/detected_offset_knob_radii above.
_reconciliation.crop_fix_2026-07-11: All crop-knob.png / crop-knob-labeled.png files were regenerated by tools/mask-align-exp/gen12/knobticks/redetect_knob.py, anchored on each gen's OWN mask.png guide-colour blob centroid (never the template), padded to >=2x the detected knob's radius beyond its edge per sota-eye-review-rule crop discipline. Verified by direct visual inspection of every new crop -- all 6 now show the knob centered and fully framed with its tick arc visible; none required the detection-failed fallback.
_reconciliation.verdict: User's overrule holds on direct re-inspection: tick DRAWING quality is strong-to-excellent on 6/7, and shape-distinct on 5/7, independent of the collateral axes. The prior 0/8 adjudicated-PASS number was a full-contract AND gate (any collateral defect = FAIL) that correctly flags the clause isn't SHIP-READY as tested, but it obscured that the failures are concentrated in COLLATERAL (baked text, layout drift, icon bleed) rather than in the tick-drawing capability itself. The layout-drift axis is WORSE than the original per-gen severity labels suggested (2 gens corrected from minor to MAJOR above) -- collateral B (layout displacement) is the dominant, most-consistent failure mode across the sample (6/7 gens, now averaging ~3.2 knob-radii of displacement), reinforcing rather than changing the product recommendation below.
